g.text: miss → fn(); put IF attempt = mine

svg.text: T2 on DynamoDB · item layout and the fenced write

g.text: checkpoints PK = thread#<job_id>#<ns> SK = cp#<checkpoint_id> ttl 14 d
journal PK = run#<job_id> SK = fx#<sha256 key> ttl 14 d
envelopes PK = run#<job_id> SK = env#<seq> ttl 14 d
# every T2 write (FencedCheckpointer, DynamoJournal, envelope store)
ConditionCheck jobs[job_id]: state = running AND attempt = :mine,
# claim (RunStore) and terminal commit keep the ADR-0013 conditions
UpdateItem jobs SET attempt = attempt + 1, state = running, lease_until = :t
IF state = queued OR (state = running AND lease_until < :now)
